definition.inspect.summary: Inspect and validate a definition library invocation offline.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms. Returned in plan; not executed here.
inputs.formatVersion: 1 for scoped format; omitted for legacy literal batches.
inputs.definitions: Object keyed by definition name; values {revision?,parameters?,inputs?:[name],operations,outputs?}.
inputs.parameters: Root literal values; definition parameters are defaults overridden explicitly at use sites.
inputs.inputs: Root named input values; child inputs must be explicitly bound.
inputs.outputs: Named values/$ref exports. Child exports addressed as id.outputs.name; loops as id.outputs.0.name.
inputs.maxExpansion: Total visited nodes including loop iterations; integer 1..100000, default 10000. Depth capped at 128.
inputs.runId: Optional for inspection; defaults to inspection.
inputs.mode: validate|preview|run accepted but never executed here.
inputs.recipe: Optional {id,bindings:[{parameter,input,target:{$ref:path},name?,role?}]} for native model parameter regeneration.

limitations: Offline structural validation only. No entity resolution, output field validation or kernel evaluation. Display names remain explicit literals; IDs are scoped, names are not automatically prefixed.
No filesystem imports inside definitions. All definitions are embedded in the CLI-local --file payload; no eval or executable code.

definition.expand.summary: Compile scoped definitions and bounded loops to the existing ordered batch engine.

inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive integer scheduling budget; scoped default 180000 ms. Returned in plan; not executed here.
inputs.operations: Leaf/use/repeat/forEach nodes; see definition inspect and docs/DEFINITIONS.md.

limitations: Same validation as inspect, returning all flattened operations, symbolic exports and scope/step/mutation plan. Native feasibility remains untested.

definition.recipe.summary: Record durable recipe ownership before and after a batch; normally called by the batch engine.

inputs.action: begin|complete. begin is exclusive; incomplete recipes cannot be reused.
inputs.recipe: {id,bindings}; same declaration on begin and complete.
inputs.sourceHash: SHA256 supplied by the batch engine.
inputs.source: Required for begin: embedded full source and bindings.
inputs.bindings: Required for complete: {parameter,input,target,name?,role?}; input is the leaf payload path being driven.
inputs.created: Actual batch output created refs; every adopted timeline entity must be present.

limitations: Requires --doc-file-id, saved parametric design at history end. Persistent root attributes, no implicit document save. Existing recipe IDs are refused; this is not an adoption API.
Completion owns appended timeline entities only, requires unchanged earlier feature parameters and explicit bindings. Failure leaves an incomplete recipe for inspection, never automatic replay.

definition.regenerate.summary: Preflight or update owned native model parameter bindings from the durable recipe.

inputs.sourceHash: Exact stored source hash. Changed/missing source is blocked; no implicit migration.
inputs.parameters: Partial map of bound root parameter names to dimensional expression strings.
inputs.dryRun: Boolean, default true. false explicitly applies the validated plan.

limitations: Requires --doc-file-id. In-place native model-parameter updates only: no delete/rebuild, changing counts/structure/names or unbound literals is blocked.

Conservative downstream fence: changed timeline membership, foreign later features, user edits, ownership loss, unsupported snapshots or unhealthy history block. No claim of a complete SDK dependency graph.

No rollback. A failed assignment/recompute/readback leaves recipe status unknown and blocks automatic retry. dryRun is read-only in the handler, but transport is conservatively mutating-capable; --preview is only outer CLI validation.
